elements.description_zh: 收敛、静与凉的意象。故事从这里的一半开始。
elements.description_en: An image of quiet, coolness and inward movement. One half of the beginning.

elements.description_zh: 舒展、动与暖的意象。与阴相遇，打开新的联系。
elements.description_en: An image of warmth, activity and outward movement. Meet its counterpart.

elements.description_zh: 阴阳相对相含的文化图形，用它作为本游戏展开五行的入口。
elements.description_en: A cultural figure of complementary yin and yang; the gateway to this game’s five phases.

elements.description_zh: 向上的焰形：热，让材料改变状态。
elements.description_en: An upward flame: heat makes materials change state.

elements.description_zh: 一滴水：流动、汇聚，也参与许多造物过程。
elements.description_en: A drop that flows, gathers and joins many making processes.

elements.description_zh: 层叠的地形：为生长与材料提供落脚处。
elements.description_en: Layers of ground: a place for growth and a source of materials.

elements.description_zh: 分枝的树形：生长的意象，也是一种可塑材料。
elements.description_en: A branching form: an image of growth and a workable material.

elements.description_zh: 切面的金属块：可以成为工具、结构与导体。
elements.description_en: A faceted ingot that can become a tool, structure or conductor.

elements.description_zh: 三束向上的曲线：水受热后，进入另一种状态。
elements.description_en: Three rising curves: water changes state when heated.

elements.description_zh: 聚拢的圆弧：微小水滴或冰晶组成可见的云。
elements.description_en: Gathered arcs: tiny droplets or ice crystals make a visible cloud.

elements.description_zh: 云下落线：聚集的水滴落向大地。
elements.description_en: Falling strokes beneath a cloud: gathered droplets return to the ground.

elements.description_zh: 两条蜿蜒的岸线：许多来水汇成一条路径。
elements.description_en: Two winding banks: many flows join a shared course.

elements.description_zh: 不规则的棱面：形态与纹理留下地质过程的痕迹。
elements.description_en: An angular form whose shape and texture carry geological histories.

elements.description_zh: 一组分散的小颗粒：整体形态来自颗粒的聚集。
elements.description_en: Separate grains whose arrangement gives the whole its form.

elements.description_zh: 柔软的层纹：细颗粒与水让材料可以被塑形。
elements.description_en: Soft layers: fine particles and water make a material workable.

elements.description_zh: 有口有腹的器形：材料经过成形与烧制，获得新用途。
elements.description_en: An open vessel: shaping and firing give material a new use.

elements.description_zh: 透明棱柱：加工改变了材料与光的关系。
elements.description_en: A transparent prism: processing changes a material’s relation to light.

elements.description_zh: 带有胚芽的椭圆：生长的可能性被收在小小结构中。
elements.description_en: An oval with a shoot: a small structure holds the potential for growth.

elements.description_zh: 一茎两叶：生长需要材料、能量与环境共同参与。
elements.description_en: A stem and two leaves: growth involves materials, energy and environment.

elements.description_zh: 叶与根：连接植物知识与本草文化，不代表所有植物皆可入药。
elements.description_en: Leaf and root connect plant knowledge with materia medica; not every plant is medicinal.

elements.description_zh: 一穗谷粒：从生长走向成熟与收获。
elements.description_en: A grain head: growth moves towards maturity and harvest.

elements.description_zh: 折角的薄片：纤维重新组织，成为书写的载体。
elements.description_en: A folded sheet: reorganised fibres become a surface for writing.

elements.description_zh: 墨滴与砚面：材料与工艺共同承载文字。
elements.description_en: An ink drop and inkstone: materials and craft carry written language.

elements.description_zh: 展开的双页：纸与文字组成可以传递的知识。
elements.description_en: Two open pages: paper and writing become shareable knowledge.

elements.description_zh: 细长针形：材料与形制结合，成为中医器具的文化符号。
elements.description_en: A fine needle: material and form become a cultural symbol of Chinese medicine.

elements.description_zh: 器皿上升起的水汽：本草与煎煮工艺相遇的意象。
elements.description_en: Vapour above a vessel: an image of materia medica meeting preparation craft.

elements.description_zh: 艾卷上的小焰：艾草与火的中医文化意象。
elements.description_en: A small flame above a roll: the cultural image of mugwort and fire.

elements.description_zh: 轮缘与辐条：结构让材料可以承载与转动。
elements.description_en: A rim and spokes: structure lets a material carry loads and rotate.

elements.description_zh: 带齿的轮：边缘形状让它能够与另一个轮发生联系。
elements.description_en: A toothed wheel whose edge can engage with another wheel.

elements.description_zh: 两只啮合的齿轮：联系使部件产生传动功能。
elements.description_en: Two meshing gears: their connection produces transmission.

elements.description_zh: 活塞与飞轮：组织起来的部件把能量转为运动。
elements.description_en: A piston and flywheel: organised parts turn energy into motion.

elements.description_zh: 折线闪电：为传感、信号与控制打开新的路径。
elements.description_en: A lightning stroke opens routes to sensing, signals and control.

elements.description_zh: 同心感知弧：把环境变化转为可以处理的信号。
elements.description_en: Nested sensing arcs turn environmental change into usable signals.

elements.description_zh: 一段脉冲：变化可以被编码与传递。
elements.description_en: A pulse: change can be encoded and communicated.

elements.description_zh: 相连的节点：联系的结构影响信息如何流动。
elements.description_en: Linked nodes: their arrangement affects how information flows.

elements.description_zh: 闭合的回路：输出返回并参与后续过程。
elements.description_en: A closed loop: output returns to influence what happens next.

elements.description_zh: 指针与刻度：周期运动成为可读的时间尺度。
elements.description_en: Hands and marks: periodic movement becomes a readable measure of time.

elements.description_zh: 重复的波峰：变化在时间中形成可辨认的模式。
elements.description_en: Repeated peaks: change forms a recognisable pattern in time.

elements.description_zh: 支点上的双盘：持续调整中保持的相对稳定。
elements.description_en: Two pans on a pivot: relative stability maintained through adjustment.

elements.description_zh: 有边界、有回路的节点群：部分在联系中形成整体。
elements.description_en: A bounded group of connected nodes: parts form a whole through relationships.

elements.description_zh: 无形空气以疏开的三条曲线表示，作为第二批开放的基础介质。
elements.description_en: Three open curves represent air, a basic medium added in the expanded atlas.

elements.description_zh: 一束光线，连接照明、光学与植物生长的路线。
elements.description_en: A beam of light connects illumination, optics and plant growth.

elements.description_zh: 空气受热不均形成压强差，带来流动；这里省略具体天气条件。
elements.description_en: Uneven heating creates pressure differences and moving air; weather conditions are compressed.

elements.description_zh: 以阴的凉意代表冷却条件，水在适宜温度下凝固成冰。
elements.description_en: The cool image of yin stands for cooling water until it freezes.

elements.description_zh: 云中冰晶在适宜条件下生长并降落，形成雪。
elements.description_en: Ice crystals grow and fall from clouds under suitable conditions, forming snow.

elements.description_zh: 光在水滴中折射、反射并分散，在适宜几何条件下形成虹。
elements.description_en: Light refracts, reflects and disperses in water droplets, making a rainbow at suitable angles.

elements.description_zh: 植物残体分解后与矿物颗粒相混，增添土壤中的有机质。
elements.description_en: Decomposed plant remains mix with mineral particles, adding organic matter to soil.

elements.description_zh: 以植物在土中生根为线索，发现吸收与固定的结构。
elements.description_en: A plant taking root in soil reveals a structure for uptake and anchoring.

elements.description_zh: 光周期等条件参与开花调控；本路线选取开花植物。
elements.description_en: Photoperiod and other conditions participate in flowering; this route refers to flowering plants.

elements.description_zh: 被子植物开花、授粉后发育成果实，路线省略具体条件。
elements.description_en: Flowering plants develop fruit after flowering and pollination; detailed conditions are implicit.

elements.description_zh: 多株树木形成林的集合意象；森林还包含土壤、生物及环境联系。
elements.description_en: Many trees suggest a forest, which also includes soil, organisms and environmental relationships.

elements.description_zh: 木材在限氧窑中受热形成木炭；陶器在此代表窑烧工艺。
elements.description_en: Wood heated in a low-oxygen kiln forms charcoal; pottery stands for kiln craft here.

elements.description_zh: 植物材料燃烧后留下无机灰分，得到草木灰。
elements.description_en: Burning plant material leaves inorganic mineral ash.

elements.description_zh: 黏土与适宜矿物骨料成形、烧制为砖，配方压缩成形与烧成工序。
elements.description_en: Clay with suitable mineral aggregate is shaped and fired into brick; processing is compressed.

elements.description_zh: 以含钙岩石与黏土等原料煅烧、粉磨为线索，省略其他原料和工序。
elements.description_en: Calcium-bearing rock and clay are calcined and ground; additional materials and stages are implicit.

elements.description_zh: 水泥与砂、粗骨料、水拌合后硬化；此处用两项概括复合材料。
elements.description_en: Cement, sand, coarse aggregate and water harden into concrete; two items stand for the composite process.

elements.description_zh: 以砖和泥质砌筑材料组织成墙为线索，结构来自排列与连接。
elements.description_en: Bricks with an earthen bonding material suggest a wall built through arrangement and connection.

elements.description_zh: 墙体与木构屋顶等构件组织成房屋，省略其他构件。
elements.description_en: Walls and wooden roof members are organised into a house; other parts are implicit.

elements.description_zh: 木构件跨越水道，经支承与连接形成桥的功能。
elements.description_en: Wooden members arranged across a waterway gain a bridge’s function through support and connection.

elements.description_zh: 植物材料经浸渍、捶打或碾磨提取纤维，石代表加工工具。
elements.description_en: Plant material is soaked, beaten or ground to obtain fibres; stone represents the tools.

elements.description_zh: 纤维经纺轮加捻，组织为连续的纱线。
elements.description_en: Fibres twisted with a spinning wheel become continuous thread.

elements.description_zh: 经纬纱线按结构交织，形成可以使用的织物。
elements.description_en: Warp and weft threads interlace in an organised structure to make cloth.

elements.description_zh: 布被裁制、支撑为帆，借风产生推进作用。
elements.description_en: Cloth shaped and supported as a sail catches wind to provide propulsion.

elements.description_zh: 木制船体与帆装配，借浮力、风与结构形成航行功能。
elements.description_en: A wooden hull and sail combine buoyancy, wind and structure to enable sailing.

elements.description_zh: 从含铁矿物中发现具有磁性的天然磁石，不表示所有金属都有磁性。
elements.description_en: Iron-bearing minerals include naturally magnetic lodestone; this does not imply all metals are magnetic.

elements.description_zh: 磁化的针与支承结构结合，可指示磁场方向；这里省略支承。
elements.description_en: A magnetised needle on a suitable support indicates magnetic field direction; the support is implicit.

elements.description_zh: 磁场、线圈与电流相互作用，按结构组织后产生转动。
elements.description_en: Fields, coils and current interact in an organised structure to produce rotation.

elements.description_zh: 动力使导体与磁场产生相对运动，联想到发电装置。
elements.description_en: Mechanical power moves a conductor relative to a magnetic field, suggesting a generator.

elements.description_zh: 蒸汽推动叶轮，把流体的能量转为旋转运动。
elements.description_en: Steam drives a bladed rotor, turning fluid energy into rotation.

elements.description_zh: 有动力与合适结构的机构搬运水，形成泵的功能。
elements.description_en: A powered mechanism with suitable structure moves water, acquiring a pump’s function.

elements.description_zh: 金属加工与陶制成型提供两类制管工艺，形成流体通道。
elements.description_en: Metalworking and ceramic forming offer ways to make pipes that channel fluids.

elements.description_zh: 在管道中加入可调机构，控制通道的开度与流量。
elements.description_en: An adjustable mechanism in a pipe controls its opening and flow.

elements.description_zh: 导体与元件按拓扑连接，为信号建立可运行的电路。
elements.description_en: Conductors and components arranged in a topology give signals a functioning circuit.

elements.description_zh: 两种适宜电极与电解液形成电化学装置；水代表水系电解液。
elements.description_en: Suitable electrodes and an electrolyte form an electrochemical device; water stands for an aqueous electrolyte.

elements.description_zh: 碳材料在合适结构中可以制成电阻元件，不是任意木炭皆可直接使用。
elements.description_en: Carbon materials in suitable structures can form resistors; ordinary charcoal is not a ready-made component.

elements.description_zh: 机械结构控制电路的接通与断开，形成开关。
elements.description_en: A mechanical structure opens or closes a circuit to form a switch.

elements.description_zh: 玻璃灯罩与电光源等部件组织为灯，省略具体发光材料。
elements.description_en: A glass enclosure and an electric light source are arranged as a lamp; emitting materials are implicit.

elements.description_zh: 玻璃加工成适宜曲面，改变光路，形成透镜。
elements.description_en: Glass shaped with suitable curved surfaces redirects light to form a lens.

elements.description_zh: 物镜与目镜等光学部件按距离和光路组织，形成复合显微镜。
elements.description_en: Objective and eyepiece lenses arranged along an optical path form a compound microscope.

elements.description_zh: 将玻璃加工为棱柱，利用色散把光分开；虹提供观察线索。
elements.description_en: Glass shaped as a prism disperses light; the rainbow suggests the optical effect.

elements.description_zh: 具有光伏效应的半导体与电路组织成太阳能电池，材料条件在此省略。
elements.description_en: Photovoltaic semiconductors connected to a circuit form a solar cell; material conditions are implicit.

elements.description_zh: 显示材料、玻璃基板与驱动信号共同构成显示装置。
elements.description_en: Display materials, a glass substrate and driving signals form a display.

elements.description_zh: 电路按计算结构组织，执行存储的指令；书在此代表指令记录。
elements.description_en: Computationally organised circuits execute stored instructions; the book represents instruction records.

elements.description_zh: 为记录与信号建立对应规则，形成可传递的编码。
elements.description_en: A defined mapping between records and signals creates communicable code.

elements.description_zh: 把有序、明确的操作步骤写成可执行的表示，形成算法的游戏意象。
elements.description_en: Represent ordered, explicit steps in executable form: the game’s image of an algorithm.

elements.description_zh: 记录系统的结构、变量与关系，建立针对问题的模型。
elements.description_en: Record a system’s structure, variables and relationships to build a model for a question.

elements.description_zh: 让模型在计算机中按规则运行，观察设定条件下的变化。
elements.description_en: Run a model by defined rules on a computer to observe change under specified conditions.

elements.description_zh: 按控制规则处理返回的信息，调整后续输出。
elements.description_en: Process returning information according to control rules to adjust subsequent output.

elements.description_zh: 将控制规则与执行机构连接，让任务按设定条件自动运行。
elements.description_en: Connect control rules with actuators so a task runs automatically under defined conditions.

elements.description_zh: 感知、控制与执行机构组织在一起，形成机器人的简化结构。
elements.description_en: Sensing, control and actuation are organised into a simplified robotic structure.

elements.description_zh: 把信号按规则记录，形成可回看的数据。
elements.description_en: Record signals by defined rules to create data that can be revisited.

elements.description_zh: 把数据映射为图形，让关系与变化更容易被阅读。
elements.description_en: Map data into visual forms so relationships and changes become readable.

elements.description_zh: 书籍经过收集、分类与编目，形成可以检索的书库。
elements.description_en: Books collected, classified and catalogued form a searchable library.

elements.description_zh: 记录并组织时间周期，形成便于查阅的历。
elements.description_en: Record and organise cycles of time into a calendar.

elements.description_zh: 在历法中记录年周期的物候变化，以春夏秋冬表达四时。
elements.description_en: Record annual phenological rhythms in a calendar as spring, summer, autumn and winter.

elements.description_zh: 透光围护与建筑结构相连，形成可调节栽培环境的温室。
elements.description_en: A light-transmitting enclosure and building structure form a greenhouse for managing growing conditions.

elements.description_zh: 凹石与杵配合，材料经过形制加工成为研磨工具。
elements.description_en: A hollowed stone and pestle, shaped to work together, become a grinding tool.

elements.description_zh: 合适药材经过研磨成为粉末，只展示加工形式，不提供用药建议。
elements.description_en: Suitable herbal material is ground into powder; this shows a processing form, not prescribing advice.

elements.description_zh: 把药用植物的观察与传统记载编排为本草记录。
elements.description_en: Arrange observations and traditional records of medicinal plants as materia medica.

elements.description_zh: 刻度石盘与晷针利用日影变化指示时间；晷针等构件在此省略。
elements.description_en: A marked stone dial and gnomon use changing solar shadows to indicate time; individual parts are implicit.

recipes.zh: 阴阳相遇，点亮太极图，开放金木水火土五行，以及空气与光两项基础介质。这是游戏开篇的文化意象。
recipes.en: Meet yin and yang to reveal taiji. Open the five phases plus air and light as basic media: a cultural opening for this game.

recipes.zh: 以木本植物枝条在适宜基质中生根为线索，省略栽培条件。
recipes.en: Woody cuttings root in a suitable growing medium; cultivation conditions are compressed.

recipes.zh: 以矿石经冶炼成为金属为线索，压缩材料与加工条件。
recipes.en: A compressed making rule inspired by smelting metals from ores.

recipes.zh: 加热让水汽化。这里用两个元素概括过程。
recipes.en: Heating vaporises water; two elements summarise the process.

recipes.zh: 用阴的凉意联想到水汽冷凝，以云作为新的意象。
recipes.en: The cool image of yin suggests condensation and the image of a cloud.

recipes.zh: 云中的水滴增长，形成降水的线索。
recipes.en: Growing droplets in a cloud suggest precipitation.

recipes.zh: 降水沿地表汇流，形成共同的河道。
recipes.en: Rainwater gathers across the ground into a shared river course.

recipes.zh: 将土的凝聚意象进一步放大，发现石。
recipes.en: Extend earth’s image of consolidation to discover stone.

recipes.zh: 水参与风化与搬运，岩石逐渐成为细小颗粒。
recipes.en: Water participates in weathering and transport, producing smaller grains.

recipes.zh: 从河岸细腻的泥土，联想到可塑的黏土材料。
recipes.en: Fine riverbank earth suggests workable clay.

recipes.zh: 黏土成形后经烧制，得到陶器；配方省略具体工序。
recipes.en: Shaped clay is fired into pottery; the recipe compresses the stages.

recipes.zh: 含硅原料在高温下熔融并冷却，联想到玻璃；实际配料更复杂。
recipes.en: High-temperature processing of silica-bearing material suggests glass; real batches are more complex.

recipes.zh: 以开花植物授粉、结籽的过程为线索，省略具体繁殖条件。
recipes.en: A compressed image of flowering plants pollinating and setting seed.

recipes.zh: 种子在适宜条件下萌发；土代表这里的生长环境。
recipes.en: A seed germinates under suitable conditions; earth represents its environment here.

recipes.zh: 通过本草记录识别具有药用传统的植物，打开本草文化分支。
recipes.en: Use materia medica records to recognise plants with medicinal traditions.

recipes.zh: 把水分与其他生长条件压缩为一条从种子到收获的路线。
recipes.en: A compressed route from seed to harvest, with water standing for growing conditions.

recipes.zh: 木质纤维经过制浆、抄造与干燥，成为纸。
recipes.en: Wood fibres are pulped, formed and dried into paper.

recipes.zh: 从燃烧产生的烟炱联想到制墨；实际制墨还需要胶与工艺。
recipes.en: Soot suggests ink-making, which also involves binder and further craft.

recipes.zh: 纸提供载体，墨记录文字，编排成书后知识可以传递。
recipes.en: Paper carries inked writing; arranging it into a book makes knowledge shareable.

recipes.zh: 金属经加工获得针的形制；此处概括材料与工艺的关系。
recipes.en: Working metal gives it a needle’s form; this rule summarises material meeting craft.

recipes.zh: 以药材与煎药器皿联想到药汤，省略水与加热条件。
recipes.en: Medicinal plants and a preparation vessel suggest decoction; water and heating are implicit.

recipes.zh: 本配方中的药草特指艾草，以艾与火联想到灸的文化意象。
recipes.en: Here the plant specifically stands for mugwort, paired with fire as a cultural image of moxa.

recipes.zh: 木与金属经结构设计，成为可以承载与转动的轮。
recipes.en: Wood and metal, structurally arranged, become a load-bearing rotating wheel.

recipes.zh: 轮缘获得相互配合的齿形，成为可以啮合的部件。
recipes.en: A wheel gains matching teeth and becomes a component that can mesh.

recipes.zh: 两个齿轮啮合，运动得以传递。新功能来自部件间的联系。
recipes.en: Two gears mesh and transmit motion. The new function arises from their connection.

recipes.zh: 以蒸汽驱动机构为线索，让能量通过组织起来的部件转为运动。
recipes.en: Steam driving a mechanism suggests energy becoming motion through organised parts.

recipes.zh: 从动力、导体与发电装置的联系联想到电；省略磁场等条件。
recipes.en: Power, conductors and a generator suggest electricity; fields and other conditions are implicit.

recipes.zh: 材料与电路按感知任务组织起来，联想到传感器。
recipes.en: Materials and circuits arranged for a sensing task suggest a sensor.

recipes.zh: 传感器在供电与转换条件下，将变化表达为信号。
recipes.en: A powered sensor converts change into a signal.

recipes.zh: 为信号建立连接与通信结构，发现网络。
recipes.en: Give signals a structure for connection and communication to discover a network.

recipes.zh: 将感知结果接回过程，闭合的信息回路形成反馈。
recipes.en: Return sensed information to the process; the closed information loop forms feedback.

recipes.zh: 将信号放到时间尺度中，辨认重复的节律。
recipes.en: Place a signal on a time scale to recognise repeating rhythm.

recipes.zh: 把齿轮、指针轮系与调速结构组织为钟表机构，省略具体零件。
recipes.en: Arrange gears, hands and a regulating structure as a clock; individual parts are implicit.

recipes.zh: 反馈参与周期变化中的调整，用动态平衡表达相对稳定。
recipes.en: Feedback adjusts a changing process; dynamic balance represents relative stability.

recipes.zh: 让机构与返回的输出发生联系，形成一个有回路的整体。
recipes.en: Connect a mechanism with its returning output to form a whole with a loop.

recipes.zh: 水汽与较冷的水环境相遇，联想到冷凝成云的条件。
recipes.en: Vapour meeting cooler water suggests conditions for condensation.

recipes.zh: 已经长出的植株在适宜供水等条件下，走向成熟与收获。
recipes.en: A growing crop, with suitable water and other conditions, moves towards harvest.

recipes.zh: 用电驱动组织起来的机构，联想到另一条动力机路线。
recipes.en: Electric power driving an organised mechanism suggests another route to an engine.

recipes.zh: 按时间采样感知结果，使变化成为一串可处理的信号。
recipes.en: Sampling sensed changes over time gives a sequence of usable signals.

recipes.zh: 空气受热不均形成压强差，带来流动；这里省略具体天气条件。
recipes.en: Uneven heating creates pressure differences and moving air; weather conditions are compressed.

recipes.zh: 以阴的凉意代表冷却条件，水在适宜温度下凝固成冰。
recipes.en: The cool image of yin stands for cooling water until it freezes.

recipes.zh: 云中冰晶在适宜条件下生长并降落，形成雪。
recipes.en: Ice crystals grow and fall from clouds under suitable conditions, forming snow.

recipes.zh: 光在水滴中折射、反射并分散，在适宜几何条件下形成虹。
recipes.en: Light refracts, reflects and disperses in water droplets, making a rainbow at suitable angles.

recipes.zh: 植物残体分解后与矿物颗粒相混，增添土壤中的有机质。
recipes.en: Decomposed plant remains mix with mineral particles, adding organic matter to soil.

recipes.zh: 以植物在土中生根为线索，发现吸收与固定的结构。
recipes.en: A plant taking root in soil reveals a structure for uptake and anchoring.

recipes.zh: 光周期等条件参与开花调控；本路线选取开花植物。
recipes.en: Photoperiod and other conditions participate in flowering; this route refers to flowering plants.

recipes.zh: 被子植物开花、授粉后发育成果实，路线省略具体条件。
recipes.en: Flowering plants develop fruit after flowering and pollination; detailed conditions are implicit.

recipes.zh: 多株树木形成林的集合意象；森林还包含土壤、生物及环境联系。
recipes.en: Many trees suggest a forest, which also includes soil, organisms and environmental relationships.

recipes.zh: 木材在限氧窑中受热形成木炭；陶器在此代表窑烧工艺。
recipes.en: Wood heated in a low-oxygen kiln forms charcoal; pottery stands for kiln craft here.

recipes.zh: 植物材料燃烧后留下无机灰分，得到草木灰。
recipes.en: Burning plant material leaves inorganic mineral ash.

recipes.zh: 黏土与适宜矿物骨料成形、烧制为砖，配方压缩成形与烧成工序。
recipes.en: Clay with suitable mineral aggregate is shaped and fired into brick; processing is compressed.

recipes.zh: 以含钙岩石与黏土等原料煅烧、粉磨为线索，省略其他原料和工序。
recipes.en: Calcium-bearing rock and clay are calcined and ground; additional materials and stages are implicit.

recipes.zh: 水泥与砂、粗骨料、水拌合后硬化；此处用两项概括复合材料。
recipes.en: Cement, sand, coarse aggregate and water harden into concrete; two items stand for the composite process.

recipes.zh: 以砖和泥质砌筑材料组织成墙为线索，结构来自排列与连接。
recipes.en: Bricks with an earthen bonding material suggest a wall built through arrangement and connection.

recipes.zh: 墙体与木构屋顶等构件组织成房屋，省略其他构件。
recipes.en: Walls and wooden roof members are organised into a house; other parts are implicit.

recipes.zh: 木构件跨越水道，经支承与连接形成桥的功能。
recipes.en: Wooden members arranged across a waterway gain a bridge’s function through support and connection.

recipes.zh: 植物材料经浸渍、捶打或碾磨提取纤维，石代表加工工具。
recipes.en: Plant material is soaked, beaten or ground to obtain fibres; stone represents the tools.

recipes.zh: 纤维经纺轮加捻，组织为连续的纱线。
recipes.en: Fibres twisted with a spinning wheel become continuous thread.

recipes.zh: 经纬纱线按结构交织，形成可以使用的织物。
recipes.en: Warp and weft threads interlace in an organised structure to make cloth.

recipes.zh: 布被裁制、支撑为帆，借风产生推进作用。
recipes.en: Cloth shaped and supported as a sail catches wind to provide propulsion.

recipes.zh: 木制船体与帆装配，借浮力、风与结构形成航行功能。
recipes.en: A wooden hull and sail combine buoyancy, wind and structure to enable sailing.

recipes.zh: 从含铁矿物中发现具有磁性的天然磁石，不表示所有金属都有磁性。
recipes.en: Iron-bearing minerals include naturally magnetic lodestone; this does not imply all metals are magnetic.

recipes.zh: 磁化的针与支承结构结合，可指示磁场方向；这里省略支承。
recipes.en: A magnetised needle on a suitable support indicates magnetic field direction; the support is implicit.

recipes.zh: 磁场、线圈与电流相互作用，按结构组织后产生转动。
recipes.en: Fields, coils and current interact in an organised structure to produce rotation.

recipes.zh: 动力使导体与磁场产生相对运动，联想到发电装置。
recipes.en: Mechanical power moves a conductor relative to a magnetic field, suggesting a generator.

recipes.zh: 蒸汽推动叶轮，把流体的能量转为旋转运动。
recipes.en: Steam drives a bladed rotor, turning fluid energy into rotation.

recipes.zh: 有动力与合适结构的机构搬运水，形成泵的功能。
recipes.en: A powered mechanism with suitable structure moves water, acquiring a pump’s function.

recipes.zh: 金属加工与陶制成型提供两类制管工艺，形成流体通道。
recipes.en: Metalworking and ceramic forming offer ways to make pipes that channel fluids.

recipes.zh: 在管道中加入可调机构，控制通道的开度与流量。
recipes.en: An adjustable mechanism in a pipe controls its opening and flow.

recipes.zh: 导体与元件按拓扑连接，为信号建立可运行的电路。
recipes.en: Conductors and components arranged in a topology give signals a functioning circuit.

recipes.zh: 两种适宜电极与电解液形成电化学装置；水代表水系电解液。
recipes.en: Suitable electrodes and an electrolyte form an electrochemical device; water stands for an aqueous electrolyte.

recipes.zh: 碳材料在合适结构中可以制成电阻元件，不是任意木炭皆可直接使用。
recipes.en: Carbon materials in suitable structures can form resistors; ordinary charcoal is not a ready-made component.

recipes.zh: 机械结构控制电路的接通与断开，形成开关。
recipes.en: A mechanical structure opens or closes a circuit to form a switch.

recipes.zh: 玻璃灯罩与电光源等部件组织为灯，省略具体发光材料。
recipes.en: A glass enclosure and an electric light source are arranged as a lamp; emitting materials are implicit.

recipes.zh: 玻璃加工成适宜曲面，改变光路，形成透镜。
recipes.en: Glass shaped with suitable curved surfaces redirects light to form a lens.

recipes.zh: 物镜与目镜等光学部件按距离和光路组织，形成复合显微镜。
recipes.en: Objective and eyepiece lenses arranged along an optical path form a compound microscope.

recipes.zh: 将玻璃加工为棱柱，利用色散把光分开；虹提供观察线索。
recipes.en: Glass shaped as a prism disperses light; the rainbow suggests the optical effect.

recipes.zh: 具有光伏效应的半导体与电路组织成太阳能电池，材料条件在此省略。
recipes.en: Photovoltaic semiconductors connected to a circuit form a solar cell; material conditions are implicit.

recipes.zh: 显示材料、玻璃基板与驱动信号共同构成显示装置。
recipes.en: Display materials, a glass substrate and driving signals form a display.

recipes.zh: 电路按计算结构组织，执行存储的指令；书在此代表指令记录。
recipes.en: Computationally organised circuits execute stored instructions; the book represents instruction records.

recipes.zh: 为记录与信号建立对应规则，形成可传递的编码。
recipes.en: A defined mapping between records and signals creates communicable code.

recipes.zh: 把有序、明确的操作步骤写成可执行的表示，形成算法的游戏意象。
recipes.en: Represent ordered, explicit steps in executable form: the game’s image of an algorithm.

recipes.zh: 记录系统的结构、变量与关系，建立针对问题的模型。
recipes.en: Record a system’s structure, variables and relationships to build a model for a question.

recipes.zh: 让模型在计算机中按规则运行，观察设定条件下的变化。
recipes.en: Run a model by defined rules on a computer to observe change under specified conditions.

recipes.zh: 按控制规则处理返回的信息，调整后续输出。
recipes.en: Process returning information according to control rules to adjust subsequent output.

recipes.zh: 将控制规则与执行机构连接，让任务按设定条件自动运行。
recipes.en: Connect control rules with actuators so a task runs automatically under defined conditions.

recipes.zh: 感知、控制与执行机构组织在一起，形成机器人的简化结构。
recipes.en: Sensing, control and actuation are organised into a simplified robotic structure.

recipes.zh: 把信号按规则记录，形成可回看的数据。
recipes.en: Record signals by defined rules to create data that can be revisited.

recipes.zh: 把数据映射为图形，让关系与变化更容易被阅读。
recipes.en: Map data into visual forms so relationships and changes become readable.

recipes.zh: 书籍经过收集、分类与编目，形成可以检索的书库。
recipes.en: Books collected, classified and catalogued form a searchable library.

recipes.zh: 记录并组织时间周期，形成便于查阅的历。
recipes.en: Record and organise cycles of time into a calendar.

recipes.zh: 在历法中记录年周期的物候变化，以春夏秋冬表达四时。
recipes.en: Record annual phenological rhythms in a calendar as spring, summer, autumn and winter.

recipes.zh: 透光围护与建筑结构相连，形成可调节栽培环境的温室。
recipes.en: A light-transmitting enclosure and building structure form a greenhouse for managing growing conditions.

recipes.zh: 凹石与杵配合，材料经过形制加工成为研磨工具。
recipes.en: A hollowed stone and pestle, shaped to work together, become a grinding tool.

recipes.zh: 合适药材经过研磨成为粉末，只展示加工形式，不提供用药建议。
recipes.en: Suitable herbal material is ground into powder; this shows a processing form, not prescribing advice.

recipes.zh: 把药用植物的观察与传统记载编排为本草记录。
recipes.en: Arrange observations and traditional records of medicinal plants as materia medica.

recipes.zh: 刻度石盘与晷针利用日影变化指示时间；晷针等构件在此省略。
recipes.en: A marked stone dial and gnomon use changing solar shadows to indicate time; individual parts are implicit.

recipes.zh: 植物纤维制浆、抄造与干燥，提供另一条造纸路线。
recipes.en: Plant fibres are pulped, formed and dried: another route to paper.

recipes.zh: 发电装置与闭合电路连接，将机械能转为可用电能。
recipes.en: Connect a generator with a circuit to obtain usable electrical energy.

recipes.zh: 电动机与传动轮系连接，组成能执行运动的机构。
recipes.en: Connect a motor with a wheel transmission to form a mechanism that performs motion.

recipes.zh: 将数据按映射规则在计算机中绘制，发现另一条图表路线。
recipes.en: Plot data by defined mappings on a computer: another route to a chart.
